newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate firmer, baht steady late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate firmer, baht steady late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate firmed further to 14.0 percent late on Friday from 13.50 in the morning as banks borrowed funds to meet central bank reserves requirements, dealers said.
The Bank of Thailand requires commercial banks to meet reserves requirement on seventh and 22nd of every month.
"Everybody scrambled to get funds for their reserve requirements," said a Citibank dealer.
The baht was steady to at 25.388-25.395 to the dollar late on Friday from 25.390-25.393 in the morning, but it fell against Thursday's close of 25.361-25.364.
"People are sitting on their hands. They just want to hold on to dollars to see the outcome of the debate before doing anything," said another dealer at a foreign bank.
Prime minister Banharn Silpa-archa is being grilled by the opposition at a no-confidence debate that entered its final day today. A vote on the censure is expected to be taken on Saturday.
